```aro
    (* Keep application running *)
```

```aro
    Return an <OK: status> for the <startup>.
}
```

instruction:
`aro check` reports:
```
main.aro:
  7:5: error: Expected '.', but got identifier(Create)
    hint: Statements must end with a period (.)
  7:16: error: Expected action verb (e.g., Extract, Filter, Return), but got <
  13:27: warning: Collection 'targets' used in for-each before definition
  30:9: warning: Event 'CheckFaile
```
Fix this code:
```aro
(Application-Start: Uptime Monitor) {
    Log "Uptime monitor — probing endpoints." to the <console>

    (* Targets. A real deployment loads this from a YAML file
       through `Read`; the inline list keeps the example
       self-contained. *)
    Create the <targets> with [
        "http://127.0.0.1:18791/healthy",
        "http://127.0.0.1:18791/flaky",
        "http://127.0.0.1:18791/down"
    ].

    For each <target> in <targets> {
        Request the <response> from <target>.
        Extract the <status> from the <response: status>.

        (* Record the probe — the repository row becomes a node on
           the canvas and updates every time we run. Create then
           Store is the canonical pattern (see Examples/OrderService
           for the same shape). *)
        Create the <probe> with { target: <target>, status: <status> }.
        Store the <probe> into the <probe-repository>.

        (* ARO's `when` clauses live at the *end* of a statement,
           not as a block. The same two lines compile to two
           conditional statements; the canvas paints whichever one
           the runtime fired. *)
        Log "DOWN " to the <console> when <status> >= 400.
        Log <target> to the <console> when <status> >= 400.
        Emit a <CheckFailed: event> with {
            target: <target>,
            status: <status>
        } when <status> >= 400.

        Log "OK  " to the <console> when <status> < 400.
        Log <target> to the <console> when <status> < 400.
    }

    Log "Probe sweep complete." to the <console>.

    Return an <OK: status> for the <sweep>.
}
```

```
main.aro:
  2:5: error: Expected action verb (e.g., Extract, Filter, Return), but got identifier(log)
  2:46: error: Expected action verb (e.g., Extract, Filter, Return), but got <
  Found 2 error(s) in main.aro

❌ 2 error(s) found
```
Fix this code:
```aro
(Application-Start: ErrorHandling Demo) {
    log "=== Error Handling Demo ===" to the <console>.

    (* Throw action throws an error with type and reason *)
    (* Supports verbs: Throw, Raise, Fail *)
    (* Supports preposition: for *)
    (* Syntax: Throw the <error-type> for the <reason>. *)

    (* Example 1: Validation with guarded throw *)
    Log "--- Validation Example ---" to the <console>.
    Create the <age> with 25.
    Log "Age is: " to the <console>.
    Log <age> to the <console>.

    (* This throw will NOT execute because the condition is false *)
    Throw the <ValidationError> for the <invalid-age> when <age> < 0.
    Log "Age validation passed!" to the <console>.

    (* Example 2: Authorization check with guarded throw *)
    Log "--- Authorization Example ---" to the <console>.
    Create the <product-role> with "admin".
    Log "User role is: " to the <console>.
    Log <product-role> to the <console>.

    (* This throw will NOT execute because the condition is false *)
    Throw the <AuthorizationError> for the <access-denied> when <product-role> == "guest".
    Log "Authorization check passed!" to the <console>.

    (* Example 3: Resource validation with guarded throw *)
    Log "--- Resource Validation ---" to the <console>.
    Create the <resource-exists> with true.
    Log "Resource exists: " to the <console>.
    Log <resource-exists> to the <console>.

    (* This throw will NOT execute because the condition is false *)
    Throw the <NotFoundError> for the <resource-missing> when <resource-exists> == false.
    Log "Resource validation passed!" to the <console>.

    Log "All validations passed!" to the <console>.

    (* Example 4: Throw that actually triggers *)
    Log "--- Triggered Throw Example ---" to the <console>.
    Create the <invalid-input> with -5.
    Log "Invalid input value: " to the <console>.
    Log <invalid-input> to the <console>.

    (* This throw WILL execute because the condition is true *)
    Throw the <InputError> for the <negative-value> when <invalid-input> < 0.

    (* This line should NOT be reached *)
    Log "This should not appear!" to the <console>.
    Return an <OK: status> for the <demo>.
}
```

```aro
    Log "Repo backup — nightly sweep." to the <console>.

    (* In a real deployment the repository list comes from a YAML
       file via `Read`; the inline list keeps the example
       self-contained for the canvas demo. *)
    Create the <repos> with [
        { name: "aro",    url: "https://git.ausdertechnik.de/arolang/aro.git" },
        { name: "demo-1", url: "https://git.ausdertechnik.de/arolang/aro.git" },
        { name: "demo-2", url: "https://git.ausdertechnik.de/arolang/aro.git" }
    ].

    Compute the <today> from <now>.

    For each <repo> in <repos> {
        Extract the <name> from the <repo: name>.
        Extract the <url>  from the <repo: url>.

        (* Per-repo destination — the canvas paints a fresh node
```
```aro
           every iteration so the account can see which one is in
           flight. *)
        Create the <destination> with "/tmp/backups/" + <today> + "/" + <name>.

        Log "Cloning " to the <console>.
        Log <name> to the <console>.

        (* Clone via the native Git action (ARO-0080). *)
        Clone the <result> from the <git> with {
            url: <url>,
            path: <destination>
        }.

        Store the <backup> into the <backup-repository> with {
            name: <name>,
            destination: <destination>
        }.

        Log "Done " to the <console>.
        Log <name> to the <console>.
    }

    Log "Backup sweep complete." to the <console>.

    Return an <OK: status> for the <sweep>.
}
```
